balance.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM curated_transactions) AS accepted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rejected_transactions) AS rejected

accepted_by_source.sql: SELECT source_system, COUNT(*) FROM curated_transactions GROUP BY source_system ORDER BY source_system

rejected_by_source.sql: SELECT source_system, COUNT(*) FROM rejected_transactions GROUP BY source_system ORDER BY source_system

country_analysis_1.sql:
SELECT
    c.country,
    t.currency,
    COUNT(*)      AS transaction_count,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
FROM curated_transactions t
JOIN curated_accounts  a ON a.account_id  = t.account_id
JOIN curated_customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
GROUP BY c.country, t.currency
ORDER BY c.country, t.currency

daily_transactions_1.sql:
SELECT
    transaction_date,
    currency,
    COUNT(*)    AS transaction_count,
    SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM curated_transactions
GROUP BY transaction_date, currency
ORDER BY transaction_date, currency

data_quality_1.sql:
SELECT
    reason,
    COUNT(*) AS rejected_records
FROM rejected_transactions
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(error_reasons) AS u (reason)
GROUP BY reason
ORDER BY rejected_records DESC

data_quality_2.sql:
SELECT
    source_system,
    COUNT(*) AS rejected_records
FROM rejected_transactions
GROUP BY source_system
ORDER BY rejected_records DESC

rework_report_1.sql:
SELECT
    source_system,
    reason,
    COUNT(*) AS rejected_records,
    array_join(slice(array_distinct(array_agg(transaction_id)), 1, 5), ' ') AS example_transaction_ids
FROM rejected_transactions
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(error_reasons) AS u (reason)
GROUP BY source_system, reason
ORDER BY source_system, rejected_records DESC

CSV.sql:
SELECT currency, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
                       SUM(TRY_CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_amount
                   FROM comparison_transactions_csv
                   WHERE transaction_date = '2026-01-01' GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency

Parquet.sql:
SELECT currency, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
                       FROM curated_transactions
                       WHERE transaction_date = '2026-01-01' GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency
